outlooks.summary: SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ARE EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING FROM THE LOWER OHIO VALLEY TO THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES. STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ARE ALSO FORECAST ACROSS NORTHEAST MONTANA INTO PARTS OF THE DAKOTAS AND OVERNIGHT ACROSS PORTIONS OF IOWA AND ILLINOIS. DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL ARE EXPECTED TO BE THE PRIMARY THREATS.

sections.title: OH VALLEY/CENTRAL APPALACHIANS/MID-ATLANTIC STATES
sections.text: PER 12Z UPPER-AIR ANALYSIS...A BELT OF STRENGTHENING WEST-NORTHWESTERLY WINDS ALOFT /50+ KT IN THE MID-HIGH LEVELS/ WILL CONTINUE TO OVERSPREAD THE REGION IN CONJUNCTION WITH INCREASINGLY PREVALENT CYCLONIC FLOW ALOFT WITHIN THE BASE OF THE NORTHEAST STATES/EASTERN CANADA UPPER TROUGH. A COLD FRONT...EXTENDING FROM COASTAL NEW ENGLAND TO NJ/SOUTHERN PA SOUTHWESTWARD TO ALONG THE OH RIVER...WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE SLOWLY SOUTHEASTWARD TODAY. AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT...UPPER-AIR/SURFACE ANALYSIS FEATURES A RELATIVELY MOISTURE-RICH AIR MASS CHARACTERIZED BY UPPER 60S/NEAR 70 F SURFACE DEWPOINTS WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR. WHILE MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL NOT BE OVERLY STEEP...STEEPENING LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES/AMPLE MOISTURE WILL CONTRIBUTE TO UPWARDS OF 2000-2500 J/KG MLCAPE THIS AFTERNOON. THUNDERSTORMS ARE ALREADY INCREASING AS OF LATE MORNING/MIDDAY NEAR THE FRONT/OVER THE MOUNTAINS NEAR THE PA/MD BORDER AND NEARBY WV. ALTHOUGH SOME CLOUDINESS PERSISTS SOUTH OF THE FRONT...TEMPERATURES CLIMBING THROUGH THE 80S F WILL SUPPORT A QUICK EROSION OF REMAINING CONVECTIVE INHIBITION WITH A LIKELY INCREASE IN THUNDERSTORM COVERAGE/INTENSITY THIS AFTERNOON AS STORMS SPREAD EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD...WITH

sections.title: EASTERN MT/DAKOTAS
sections.text: AN EASTWARD-MOVING LOW-AMPLITUDE SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL CROSS THE NORTHERN PORTIONS OF ID/MT/ND THIS AFTERNOON AND TONIGHT...WITH A PERIPHERAL BELT OF 50+ KT MID-LEVEL WESTERLY FLOW OVERSPREADING MT AND THE NORTHERN PLAINS. LEE SIDE LOW DEVELOPMENT WILL OCCUR NEAR THE SOUTHEAST MT/NORTHWEST WY AND WESTERN DAKOTAS BORDER VICINITY...WITH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE /50S AND EVENTUALLY LOWER 60S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS/ ADVECTING NORTH-NORTHWESTWARD ACROSS THE NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS THROUGH THE AFTERNOON/EVENING BENEATH STEEPENING LAPSE RATES. STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON OVER NORTH-CENTRAL/NORTHEAST MT WITHIN A ZONE OF FOCUSED ASCENT ACCOMPANYING THE PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND ITS ATTENDANT COLD FRONT...WITH A GRADUAL INTENSIFICATION LIKELY THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON/EVENING AS STORMS SPREAD GENERALLY EASTWARD TOWARD GREATER MOISTURE/INSTABILITY ACROSS FAR EASTERN MT/WESTERN ND. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR INCREASING TO 50+ KT WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELLS AND BOWING SEGMENTS CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL AND DOWNBURST WINDS...ALTHOUGH A TORNADO OR TWO CANNOT BE RULED OUT. FARTHER SOUTH INTO SD...THE ATMOSPHERE SHOULD REMAIN CAPPED MUCH OF THE DAY...BUT STRONG DIABATIC WARMING AND MIXING M

sections.title: MIDDLE MO VALLEY/MIDDLE MS VALLEY
sections.text: A NOCTURNALLY STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL JET /40+ KT/ AND RELATED INCREASING ISENTROPIC ASCENT NEAR/NORTH OF A WARM FRONT WILL LIKELY LEAD TO INCREASING THUNDERSTORMS LATE TONIGHT ACROSS THE REGION...WITH AN UPSTREAM MCS POTENTIALLY ALSO MOVING INTO PARTS OF THE REGION FROM THE DAKOTAS. LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE...AND SOME DAMAGING WIND RISK MAY MATERIALIZE PENDING MCS DEVELOPMENT/PERSISTENCE. ..GUYER/LEITMAN.. 06/21/2016

STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ARE ALSO FORECAST ACROSS NORTHEAST MONTANA INTO PARTS OF THE DAKOTAS AND OVERNIGHT ACROSS PORTIONS OF IOWA AND ILLINOIS. sections.title: THERE IS AN ENH RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS NW ND
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM THE OH/TN VALLEYS TO THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES/DELMARVA... ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM THE NORTHERN PLAINS TO THE UPPER MIDWEST/MIDDLE MS VALLEY... ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM THE NORTHERN PLAINS TO THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES...

sections.title: 20Z UPDATE
sections.text: PRIMARY UPDATE FOR THIS OUTLOOK IS TO INTRODUCE AN ENH AREA ACROSS WRN ND /DISCUSSED IN MORE DETAIL BELOW/. SVR RISK PERSISTS ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE OH VALLEY AND MID-ATLANTIC WITH WW 278 AND 279 ADDRESSING THE SEVERE THREAT. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION REGARDING THIS REGION CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MCD 1004. FARTHER W...ELEVATED TSTMS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL ARE STILL ANTICIPATED TONIGHT ACROSS THE MID MS/MID MO VALLEY AS THE LLJ ENHANCES WAA IN THE VICINITY OF THE WARM FRONT.

sections.title: ERN MT/DAKOTAS
sections.text: MODERATE UPSLOPE FLOW CONTINUES ACROSS THE REGION WITH RECENT SURFACE OBSERVATIONS REVEALING DEWPOINTS IN THE MID TO UPPER 50S TO THE NORTH OF A DEEPENING SURFACE LOW CENTERED ACROSS SE MT. A WARM FRONT EXTENDS FROM THIS LOW SEWD ACROSS CNTRL SD AND INTO THE MID MO VALLEY. LEE TROUGH ALSO EXTENDS NWWD FROM THIS LOW INTO SWRN MANITOBA. CONVECTIVE INITIATION IS PROBABLE ALONG THIS LEE TROUGH...PARTICULARLY NEAR THE TRIPLE POINT WHERE THE LEE TROUGHING INTERSECTS THE WARM FRONT /WHICH WILL SLOWLY DEVELOP NWD/. RECENT CONVECTION-ALLOWING GUIDANCE SHOWS A CONSISTENT SIGNAL FOR INITIAL SUPERCELLULAR DEVELOPMENT ACROSS FAR NE MT WITH EVENTUAL UPSCALE GROWTH INTO AN MCS WHICH TRACKS SEWD ACROSS ND. WITH THIS SCENARIO IN MIND...A SMALL 30-PERCENT WIND AREA WAS INTRODUCED ACROSS NW ND. GIVEN THE STRENGTH OF THE LOW AND MID-LEVEL FLOW...A SIGWIND AREA WAS ALSO ADDED. 5-PERCENT TORNADO AREA WAS ALSO EXTENDED SLIGHTLY ESEWD TO ACCOUNT FOR THE INCREASED TORNADO THREAT COINCIDENT WITH A STRENGTHENING LLJ AND POTENTIAL DISCRETE STORM MODE. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION REGARDING SHORT-TERM TRENDS ACROSS THIS REGION CAN BE FOUND IN MCD 1005. ..MOSIER.. 06/21/2016 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1130 AM CDT TU

outlooks.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ARE FORECAST ACROSS THE NORTHERN PLAINS THIS EVENING AND MID MISSOURI VALLEY INTO THE MID MISSISSIPPI VALLEY OVERNIGHT. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS ARE EXPECTED TO BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. SCATTERED MARGINALLY SEVERE STORMS ARE EXPECTED THIS EVENING FROM THE SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS EASTWARD TO THE ATLANTIC COAST. A FEW DAMAGING WIND GUSTS MAY OCCUR ACROSS PARTS OF MARYLAND...NEW JERSEY AND NORTHEASTERN VIRGINIA OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS.

sections.title: NRN PLAINS/MID MO VALLEY/MID MS VALLEY
sections.text: ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY...A PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS EVIDENT OVER THE NRN ROCKIES. THIS FEATURE WILL MOVE QUICKLY ENEWD INTO THE NRN PLAINS TONIGHT. AT THE SFC...A 1001 MB LOW IS LOCATED IN SE MT WITH A MOIST AIRMASS IN PLACE ACROSS MUCH OF THE NRN PLAINS. SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE 50S F ACROSS MOST OF ND INTO NRN SD WITH 60S F IN SRN SD. AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY IS LOCATED IN THE WRN DAKOTAS WHERE SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE DEVELOPING. CONVECTIVE COVERAGE IS EXPECTED TO MARKEDLY INCREASE THIS EVENING AS THE LEADING EDGE OF LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THE APPROACHING SYSTEM...MOVES FROM WEST TO EAST ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS. AT MID-LEVELS...A WELL-DEFINED 50 TO 70 KT JET IS MOVING INTO THE NRN PLAINS. THIS FEATURE IS CREATING STRONG DEEP-LAYER SHEAR PROFILES WHICH WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SEVERE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT THIS EVENING. WIND GUSTS ABOVE 65 KT AND HAILSTONES GREATER THAN 2 INCHES IN DIAMETER MAY OCCUR IN WRN ND AS A SUPERCELL MOVES EWD OUT OF NERN MT AND OTHER SUPERCELLS DEVELOP ACROSS WRN ND THIS EVENING. SHORT-TERM MODELS INCLUDING THE HRRR SUGGEST THIS ACTIVITY WILL GRADUALLY ORGANIZE INTO A PERSISTENT CONVECTIVE CLUSTER ACROSS THE CNTRL DAKOTAS LATE T

sections.title: SRN APPALACHIAN MTNS/MID-ATLANTIC/NRN NC
sections.text: LATEST WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS A LARGE-SCALE UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH ACROSS THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS EXTENDING SWD INTO THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION AND CAROLINAS. AT THE SFC...A TROUGH IN THE LEE OF THE APPALACHIANS IS PRESENT WITH A MOIST AIRMASS LOCATED ACROSS MUCH OF THE REGION. POCKETS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY ARE ANALYZED BY THE RAP FROM TN VALLEY ENEWD INTO VA AND PARTS OF THE MID-ATLANTIC WHERE SCATTERED STRONG THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING. REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS SHOW UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND PROFILES ABOVE 1 KM WITH 40 TO 50 KT OF WLY FLOW IN THE MID-LEVELS. THIS WIND PROFILE SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR STORM ORGANIZATION WITH AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT POSSIBLE OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. THE GREATEST POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE STORMS WILL LIKELY BE ACROSS PARTS OF SE PA...MD AND ERN VA WHERE THE STRONGEST INSTABILITY IS LOCATED ON A REGIONAL SCALE AND A SLIGHT RISK HAS BEEN RETAINED. ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS THROUGH ABOUT 03Z. ..BROYLES.. 06/22/2016

mesoscale_discussions.summary: INCREASING AND INTENSIFYING THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED ACROSS THE REGION...INCLUDING THE WASHINGTON D.C./BALTIMORE METRO AREAS...BY MID AFTERNOON. A SEVERE WEATHER WATCH IS LIKELY WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS HAVE INITIATED ALONG THE EASTERN SLOPES OF THE ALLEGHENY MOUNTAINS...NEAR A SURFACE FRONT ACROSS SOUTHERN PENNSYLVANIA...SOUTHWARD INTO PARTS OF NORTHWESTERN VIRGINIA. A DIVERGENT UPPER FLOW FIELD ON THE SOUTHERN PERIPHERY OF A BROAD CLOSED LOW CENTERED NEAR HUDSON BAY APPEARS TO BE SUPPORTING ACTIVITY...WHICH IS EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY INCREASE WHILE PROPAGATING OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN BETWEEN NOW AND 17-19Z. A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER /CHARACTERIZED BY SURFACE DEW POINTS OF 70F+/ ACROSS MUCH OF NORTHERN VIRGINIA INTO NORTHERN MID ATLANTIC COASTAL AREAS IS DESTABILIZING WITH INSOLATION...WITH MIXED LAYER CAPE ALREADY ESTIMATED ON THE ORDER OF 1500-2000 J/KG AND LOCALLY HIGHER. ALTHOUGH LOW/MID-LEVEL THERMAL LAPSE RATES ARE NOT PARTICULARLY STEEP...SEASONABLY HIGH MOISTURE CONTENT PROBABLY WILL BECOME INCREASING CONDUCIVE TO POTENTIAL FOR WET DOWNBURSTS WITH FURTHER BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING THIS AFTERNOON. BENEATH 40-50 KT WEST NORTHWESTERLY 500 MB FLOW...VERTICAL SHEAR APPEARS MORE THAN SUFFICIENT FOR ORGANIZED CONVECTION. THIS MAY INCLUDE ISOLATED SUPERCELLS...WITH AT LEAST SOME POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE HAIL. THE EVOLUTION OF AN UPSCALE GROWING MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM SEEMS POSSIBLE...WHICH COULD BE ACCOMPANIED BY BROADER-SCALE DAMAGING WIND GUST POTENTIAL ACROSS THE CHESAPEAKE/DELMARVA PENINSULA AREA BY LATE AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCALLY STRONG SURFACE GUSTS ARE POSSIBLE WITH ONGOING STORM DEVELOPMENT. DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL MAY GRADUALLY INCREASE WITH AN EVOLVING CLUSTER OR TWO OF STORMS BY LATE AFTERNOON. A WATCH IS POSSIBLE WITHIN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS HAVE INITIATED ACROSS THE WESTERN SLOPES OF THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS...AND ALONG A SURFACE COLD FRONT ROUGHLY NEAR THE OHIO RIVER. THIS APPEARS MOSTLY IN RESPONSE TO INSOLATION AND ASSOCIATED BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZATION IN THE PRESENCE OF RELATIVELY WEAK MID-LEVEL INHIBITION. MIXED LAYER CAPE ALONG AND SOUTH OF THE FRONT HAS BECOME MODERATELY LARGE /1500-2000+ J PER KG/...ON THE SOUTHERN FRINGE OF THE STRONGER WESTERLIES...WITH WEST NORTHWESTERLY DEEP LAYER MEAN FLOW RANGING FROM 30-50 KT. FOCUSED FORCING FOR LARGE-SCALE ASCENT REMAINS UNCLEAR. HOWEVER...WITH TIME...INCREASING THUNDERSTORM COVERAGE AND INTENSITY APPEARS PROBABLE THROUGH 18-21Z. CONSOLIDATION OF CONVECTIVELY GENERATED SURFACE COLD POOLS MAY GRADUALLY LEAD TO AN UPSCALE GROWING STORM CLUSTER OR CLUSTERS. AS THIS OCCURS...DAMAGING SURFACE GUST POTENTIAL MAY TRANSITION FROM A RATHER LOCALIZED TO MORE WIDESPREAD THREAT...AIDED BY FURTHER STEEPENING OF LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES OUTSIDE OF CONVECTION WITH ADDITIONAL SURFACE HEATING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: RISK FOR SEVERE STORMS CONTINUES THROUGH 21-23Z...MOSTLY TO THE SOUTH OF THE WASHINGTON D.C. AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: PORTION OF EVOLVING THUNDERSTORM CLUSTER WITH BOW ECHO REFLECTIVITY SIGNATURE APPEARS LIKELY TO CONTINUE SOUTHEASTWARD PROPAGATION... SOUTH THROUGH SOUTHEAST OF DOVER...AND OFF THE DELAWARE COAST WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO. OUTFLOW ASSOCIATED WITH THIS SYSTEM HAS ADVANCED INTO SOUTHERN PORTIONS OF THE GREATER WASHINGTON D.C. METRO AREA...AND COULD STILL PROVIDE A FOCUS FOR ANOTHER EVOLVING CLUSTER OF STORMS...BENEATH SEASONABLY STRONG WEST NORTHWEST MID-LEVEL FLOW ACROSS SOUTHERN MARYLAND AND THE SOUTHERN DELMARVA PENINSULA THROUGH 21-23Z. OTHERWISE...FARTHER TO THE SOUTHWEST AND SOUTH...DISCRETE STORMS ARE IN THE PROCESS OF PROPAGATING EAST SOUTHEAST OF THE BLUE RIDGE MOUNTAINS. AT LEAST ONE OR TWO OF THESE MAY INTENSIFY FURTHER...IN THE PRESENCE OF MODERATE LARGE BOUNDARY LAYER CAPE...AND COULD STILL POSE A RISK FOR SEVERE WIND/HAIL ACROSS AND EAST OF THE INTERSTATE 95 CORRIDOR...AS FAR SOUTH AS THE RICHMOND AREA. ..KERR.. 06/21/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORM THREAT WILL INCREASE ACROSS PARTS OF NORTHEAST MT INTO WESTERN ND THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE AND A WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED BY 22Z. FURTHER WEST...A FEW MARGINALLY SEVERE STORMS ALSO WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS NORTH-CENTRAL MT. SMALL HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS ARE POSSIBLE WITH THESE STORMS...BUT A WATCH IS NOT EXPECTED FURTHER WEST.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS WERE ONGOING TO THE WEST OF HVR EARLY THIS AFTERNOON IN LOW LEVEL UPSLOPE FLOW REGIME. SOME SMALL HAIL AND STRONG WINDS HAVE BEEN NOTED WITH THIS CONVECTION...BUT ACTIVITY APPEARS TO BE SUB-SEVERE. THESE STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO TRACK EASTWARD INTO BETTER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WHERE DEWPOINTS WERE IN THE MID TO UPPER 50S ACROSS NE MT. WHILE CAPPING STILL EXISTS DOWNSTREAM OF CURRENT STORMS...CONTINUED HEATING/MODEST INCREASES IN MOISTURE COUPLED WITH INCREASED FORCING FOR ASCENT AS THE UPPER SHORTWAVE TRACKS EASTWARD...SHOULD RESULT IN EROSION OF THE CAP AND AN INCREASE IN STORM INTENSITY ACROSS NE MT AND EVENTUALLY NW ND LATER THIS EVENING. STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND FAVORABLE VERTICAL SHEER PROFILES WILL SUPPORT ROTATING UPDRAFTS CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL. 50+ KT 0-6 KM SHEAR ALSO WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELLS AND BOWING SEGMENTS WITH STRONG DOWNBURST WINDS. UPSCALE GROWTH INTO AN EAST/SOUTHEASTWARD PROPAGATING MCS WILL BE POSSIBLE DURING THE EVENING INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS ACROSS PARTS OF WESTERN ND. GIVEN CURRENT TRENDS IN HI-RES DATA...AN UPGRADE TO AN ENHANCED RISK APPEARS PRUDENT IN THE FORTHCOMING 20Z DAY 1 CONVECTIVE OUTLOOK. ADDITIONALLY...A WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED ACROSS PARTS OF NE MT INTO WRN ND BY 22Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AT LEAST SOME RISK FOR SEVERE HAIL/WIND GUSTS CONTINUES...BUT THUNDERSTORM INTENSITIES MAY HAVE PEAKED ACROSS MUCH OF THE REGION. TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED...BUT ADDITIONAL SEVERE WEATHER WATCHES ARE NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY HAS BECOME INCREASINGLY WIDESPREAD WITHIN A CORRIDOR OF STRONGER DESTABILIZATION TO THE SOUTH OF THE FRONT NEAR THE OHIO RIVER. INTENSITIES MAY HAVE ALREADY GENERALLY PEAKED TO THE WEST OF THE APPALACHIANS...WHERE FORCING FOR LARGE-SCALE ASCENT REMAINS LIMITED. LITTLE SUBSTANTIVE FURTHER DESTABILIZATION OF WEAK TO MODEST BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZATION AHEAD OF ACTIVITY...ACROSS THE TENNESSEE VALLEY AND SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS...IS EXPECTED. IT IS POSSIBLE THAT NEWEST STORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS PARTS OF CENTRAL INTO WESTERN KENTUCKY COULD STILL UNDERGO A PERIOD OF INTENSIFICATION IN THE PEAK AFTERNOON INSTABILITY. HOWEVER...DEEP LAYER WEST NORTHWESTERLY MEAN FLOW AND SHEAR BECOME PROGRESSIVELY WEAKER WITH SOUTHWESTWARD EXTENT ACROSS THIS REGION...WHICH IS EXPECTED TO LIMIT THE OVERALL SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL. WEAKENING CONVECTIVE TRENDS INDICATED IN THE MOST RECENT HIGH RESOLUTION RAPID REFRESH OUTPUT BY 22-23Z APPEAR SUPPORTED BY LATEST TRENDS. ..KERR.. 06/21/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS MAY PRODUCE STRONG WIND GUSTS AND HAIL INTO THE EVENING HOURS. A WATCH DOES NOT APPEAR IMMEDIATELY NECESSARY...BUT TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED CLOSELY FOR ANY INCREASING SEVERE THREAT INTO THE EVENING HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS HAVE DEVELOPED OVER NE WY IN VICINITY OF SFC TROUGH AND LOW LEVEL UPSLOPE REGIME. AS THE STORMS DEVELOP EASTWARD INTO WRN SD/NEB PANHANDLE...MOISTURE QUICKLY INCREASES INTO THE MID 50S TO LOW 60S F. HOWEVER...CAPPING ALSO INCREASES WITH EASTWARD EXTENT. THIS WILL LIKELY LIMIT MORE WIDESPREAD/LONGER-LIVED SEVERE THREAT...BUT A FEW STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE. DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE MAIN CONCERN GIVEN LARGE TEMPERATURE-DEWPOINT SPREADS AND DCAPE GREATER THAN 1000 J/KG...THOUGH SOME HAIL IS ALSO POSSIBLE GIVEN FAVORABLE DEEP LAYER SHEAR PROFILES AND STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES. SOME HI-RES GUIDANCE INDICATES SOME UPSCALE GROWTH IS POSSIBLE...BUT CONFIDENCE IS LOW IN THIS SCENARIO GIVEN THE AFOREMENTIONED CAPPING PROBLEMS IN ADDITION TO WEAKER FORCING FOR ASCENT AS THE UPPER SHORTWAVE TROUGH REMAINS FURTHER NORTH ACROSS MT AND ND. A WATCH DOES NOT APPEAR IMMEDIATELY NECESSARY BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED INTO THE EVENING FOR INCREASING SEVERE POTENTIAL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: GREATEST SEVERE THREAT WILL EXIST WITH STORMS DEVELOPING ACROSS NORTHERN VA AND VICINITY OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL REPORTS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE. GRADUALLY THIS EVENING...CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING AND SLOW BOUNDARY-LAYER COOLING SHOULD TEMPER THE SEVERE THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST WSR-88D DATA DEPICT THE STRONGEST CONVECTION EXISTING ACROSS NORTHERN PORTIONS OF WATCH 278. ELSEWHERE...STRATIFORM PRECIPITATION AND SOME BOUNDARY-LAYER STABILIZATION HAS REDUCED THE SEVERE THREAT. ACROSS NORTHERN AREAS...KLWX VWP DATA AND MESO-ANALYSIS SUGGEST AROUND 50-55 KTS OF DEEP-LAYER SHEAR IS AVAILABLE FOR CONTINUED UPDRAFT ROTATION/ORGANIZATION. ADDITIONALLY...THIS AREA REMAINS SOUTH OF THE SFC FRONT...SUCH THAT LOW-LEVEL CONFLUENCE IS SUPPORTING NEW CONVECTIVE INITIATION. POCKETS OF RELATIVELY PRISTINE AIR...WITH TEMPS IN THE UPPER 70S AND DEW POINTS IN THE UPPER 60S...WILL CONTINUE TO ENCOURAGE MORE VIGOROUS UPDRAFTS. INDEED...KLWX DATA DISPLAY A FEW SUPERCELLULAR STRUCTURES...WITH CELLS OVER LOUDOUN COUNTY AND PRINCE GEORGES COUNTIES EXHIBITING ZDR ARC SIGNATURES -- INDICATIVE OF A STORM-RELATIVE WIND PROFILE VEERING WITH HEIGHT. AS SUCH...THE THREAT FOR A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL REPORTS SHOULD CONTINUE FOR AT LEAST A COUPLE MORE HOURS. ..PICCA.. 06/21/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR AN ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUST REMAINS...BUT SHOULD FURTHER DIMINISH THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WHILE A FEW STRONG THUNDERSTORMS ARE PERSISTING WITHIN/NEAR THE REMAINDER OF WATCH 278...A FURTHER DOWNWARD TREND IN INTENSITY IS EXPECTED. NEW DEVELOPMENT ALONG RESIDUAL COLD POOL BOUNDARIES MAY LOCALLY ENHANCE THE STRONG WIND THREAT...ESPECIALLY WHERE THE BOUNDARY LAYER HAS NOT BEEN MODIFIED BY PREVIOUS CONVECTION. HOWEVER...SOUTHWARD PROPAGATION WILL REMOVE THESE CELLS FROM STRONGER FLOW ALOFT. ADDITIONALLY...DOWNSTREAM STRATIFORM PRECIPITATION AND GRADUAL NOCTURNAL COOLING WILL FURTHER REDUCE LOW-LEVEL BUOYANCY. THEREFORE...WHILE A CELL OR TWO MAY BRIEFLY INTENSIFY TO NEAR-SEVERE LEVELS...THE OVERALL THREAT SHOULD CONTINUE TO DIMINISH OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. ..PICCA.. 06/22/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE SUPERCELLS WILL CONTINUE TO PRIMARILY POSE A RISK FOR LARGE TO VERY LARGE HAIL THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 00Z SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACES A LOW NEAR THE DAKOTAS/MT BORDER WITH A FRONTAL ZONE EXTENDING SE TO NW ACROSS WRN ND INTO NERN MT. RICHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE INVOF THE FRONT IS EVIDENT WITHIN A NARROW CORRIDOR OF UPPER 50S TO LOWER 60S SURFACE DEWPOINTS. THE 00Z GGW RAOB EXHIBITED AN IMPRESSIVE WIND PROFILE WITH ELY LOW LEVEL FLOW SURMOUNTED BY STRENGTHENING/VEERING FLOW IN THE MID TO HIGH LEVELS--YIELDING 90-KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR. THE STRENGTH OF THE FLOW AHEAD OF THE APPROACHING SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL STRONGLY FAVOR DISCRETE STORMS INITIALLY VIA STRONG ANVIL-LEVEL FLOW AND THE DISPERSING OF HYDROMETEORS DOWNSTREAM. AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER COOLS REDUCING SURFACE TEMP/DEWPOINT SPREADS...THE POTENTIAL FOR LOWER-LEVEL MESOCYCLONE DEVELOPMENT WILL PROBABLY INCREASE FOR THE STRONGEST STORMS. AS THIS OCCURS...A LOW RISK FOR A TORNADO MAY DEVELOP BUT THE POTENTIAL FOR LARGE TO VERY LARGE HAIL WILL PROBABLY BE THE MAIN THREAT --ALONG WITH ISOLATED SEVERE GUSTS-- AS STORMS MOVE INTO THE MOIST AXIS OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ..SMITH.. 06/22/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR ISOLATED LARGE HAIL/SEVERE GUSTS WILL CONTINUE THROUGH THE MID-EVENING HOURS. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR THE POSSIBILITY OF A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH BEING NEEDED DOWNSTREAM OF SEVERE WATCH 281.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE ANALYSIS SHOWS THE NRN PERIPHERY OF VERY RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE OVER N-CNTRL NEB AND S-CNTRL SD /UPPER 60S SURFACE DEWPOINTS/. THE INITIAL STORMS NEAR THE BLACK HILLS HAVE MOVED EWD TOWARDS THE MO RIVER NEAR PIR AND HAVE WEAKENED IN THE PAST HOUR. THIS APPEARS TO BE RELATED TO THE STRENGTH OF THE CAP/MLCINH LOCATED FARTHER E WHEN MODIFYING THE 00Z RAP RAOB FOR SURFACE CONDITIONS. THE 00Z RAP RAOB FEATURED VERY STEEP H7-H5 LAPSE RATES /9.3 DEG C PER KM/ AND A WIND PROFILE VEERING FROM ELY TO WLY NOT FAR ABOVE THE SURFACE AND STRENGTHENING WITH HEIGHT TO 70-KT AROUND 300 MB. AS A RESULT...ORGANIZED STORMS WILL BE STRONGLY FAVORED GIVEN THE COMBINATION OF BUOYANCY/SHEAR. THE STORMS MANAGING TO BECOME SUPERCELLS WILL POSE THE GREATEST HAIL/WIND HAZARD. BY MID TO LATE EVENING...THE LOW LEVEL JET IS FORECAST TO INTENSIFY WITH THE TERMINUS OF THE SPEED MAX NEAR THE SD/NEB BORDER. STRONG MOISTURE FLUX/ISENTROPIC LIFT WILL BECOME MORE SUPPORTIVE FOR ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER CNTRL SD AND POSSIBLY INTO ERN SD AHEAD OF THE SURFACE LOW TO THE W. IT REMAINS UNCERTAIN THE TIMING/LOCATION OF ADDITIONAL STORM COVERAGE. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH DOWNSTREAM OVER ERN SD. ..SMITH.. 06/22/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED LARGE HAIL/SEVERE GUST RISK WILL LIKELY SPREAD DOWNSTREAM FROM SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 281. ADDITIONAL STORMS ARE FORECAST TO DEVELOP...INTENSIFY...AND BECOME STRONG/SEVERE LATER THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS A FEW STRONG/SEVERE STORMS W OF THE MO RIVER IN CNTRL SD WITHIN A STRONGLY SHEARED/BUOYANT AIRMASS. A FRONT ADVANCING SLOWLY NWD AS A WARM FRONT WILL LIKELY FOCUS ADDITIONAL STRONG/SEVERE STORMS AS ISENTROPIC ASCENT/MOISTURE TRANSPORT INCREASES THIS EVENING AS THE LLJ INTENSIFIES. LARGE HAIL WILL LIKELY BE THE PRIMARY RISK BUT SEVERE WIND GUST POTENTIAL MAY INCREASE...ESPECIALLY IF STORMS CAN CONGEAL INTO A CLUSTER AND GROW UPSCALE INTO A FORWARD-PROPAGATING CLUSTER LATER TONIGHT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR ISOLATED LARGE HAIL MAY EXPAND IN COVERAGE THROUGH THE LATE EVENING. IT SEEMS INCREASINGLY PROBABLE A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL BE NEED TO BE ISSUED BETWEEN 04-08Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS A SEVERE HAIL-PRODUCING SUPERCELL OVER SRN IA ON THE SWRN FLANK OF WEAKER TSTMS. A FRONTAL ZONE DRAPED NW TO SE OVER THE REGION IS FOCUSING TSTM DEVELOPMENT THIS EVENING AND WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO DO SO THROUGH THE LATE EVENING/OVERNIGHT HOURS. THE EWD ADVECTION OF STEEP H7-H5 LAPSE RATES WILL LIKELY RESULT IN A THERMODYNAMIC PROFILE BECOMING INCREASINGLY FAVORABLE FOR LARGE HAIL GROWTH WITH TIME. ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT IS PROBABLE AND SUGGESTED BY HOURLY TIME-LAGGED HRRR MODEL GUIDANCE AS SWLY H85 FLOW STRENGTHENS TONIGHT. ISENTROPIC LIFT/MOISTENING PROCESSES WILL LIFT PARCELS TO THEIR LFC AND EVENTUALLY LEAD TO SCTD THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOPING SOMETIME BETWEEN 04-08Z. STRONG EFFECTIVE SHEAR AND AMPLE ELEVATED BUOYANCY WILL SUPPORT THE POTENTIAL FOR ELEVATED SUPERCELLS WITH AN INCIPIENT THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND PERHAPS A MORE LOCALIZED DAMAGING-WIND RISK.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED RISK FOR LARGE HAIL/STRONG GUSTS WILL CONTINUE FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC OVER THE PAST HOUR HAS SHOWN SEVERAL STORMS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL OVER CNTRL AND SRN ND PER MRMS MESH DATA. MUCH OF THE ONGOING TSTM ACTIVITY HAS MOVED THROUGH THE LOW-LEVEL MOIST AXIS THAT EXTENDED FROM S-CNTRL SD NWWD INTO WRN ND. ELY FLOW NEAR THE SURFACE OVER THE ERN HALF OF ND WILL LIKELY ONLY MARGINALLY MOISTEN WITH TIME OWING TO A REINFORCEMENT OF SURFACE HIGH PRESSURE OVER SRN MANITOBA/WRN ONTARIO IN WAKE OF A DEPARTING SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER ERN ONTARIO. NONETHELESS...AN ADEQUATE FEED OF CONDITIONALLY UNSTABLE PARCELS FROM THE S/SW WILL SUPPORT THE POTENTIAL FOR VIGOROUS UPDRAFTS. THE STRONGER H5 HEIGHT FALLS /60+ M PER 12 HR/ PER EVENING UPPER-AIR ANALYSIS ARE BEGINNING TO OVERSPREAD WRN AND CNTRL ND LATE THIS EVENING. THE STRONG LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT/SHEAR WILL PROBABLY CONTRIBUTE TO AT LEAST A STRONG/ISOLATED SEVERE RISK CONTINUING FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ..SMITH.. 06/22/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT CONTINUES FOR THE REMAINING COUNTIES IN SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 282. A LOCAL WATCH EXTENSION IN TIME MAY BE NEEDED PRIOR TO WATCH 282 EXPIRATION AT 07Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: REGIONAL RADAR COMPOSITES AT 0610Z SHOW A COUPLE OF CLUSTERS OF STRONG/SEVERE STORMS...ONE OVER SOUTH-CENTRAL ND IN WW 282 AND THE OTHER OVER CENTRAL SD...BOTH WITH RADAR INDICATIONS OF SEVERE HAIL AND WINDS. A COMPACT UPPER-LEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER MT IS PROVIDING LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ACROSS THE REGION...AND MODERATE-LOCALLY STRONG ELEVATED INSTABILITY REMAINS PRESENT ALONG WITH AMPLE EFFECTIVE SHEAR /60-70 KTS/. THE SEVERE THREAT WITH WW 282 MAY CONTINUE FOR A FEW MORE HOURS AS STORMS MOVE THROUGH A FAVORABLE LARGE-SCALE ENVIRONMENT...AND THEREFORE A LOCAL WATCH EXTENSION IN TIME MAY BE NEEDED PRIOR TO WW 282 EXPIRATION...MAINLY OVER PORTIONS OF SOUTHERN ND AND NORTHERN SD AS THE STORMS EAST OF BISMARCK CONTINUE MOVING SOUTHEAST WITH A SEVERE WIND/HAIL THREAT. FARTHER SOUTH...THE CENTRAL SD CLUSTER OF STRONG/SEVERE STORMS HAVE SHOWN A TENDENCY TO FLUCTUATE IN INTENSITY OVER THE PAST HOUR. AS THESE STORMS CONTINUE EAST/SOUTHEAST NORTH OF A SURFACE WARM FRONT...WEAKENING WARM-AIR ADVECTION MAY LIMIT THE OVERALL SEVERE THREAT WITH TIME...HOWEVER AT LEAST SOME CONTINUED INTERMITTENT SEVERE THREAT WILL REMAIN IN THE SHORT TERM. ..BUNTING.. 06/22/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 283 AND 284.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A DEVELOPING LINE OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WAS LOCATED OVER NORTHWEST IA AT 0725Z...WITH STRONG/OCCASIONALLY SEVERE STORMS ENTERING NORTHWEST PORTIONS OF WW 283 IN THE VICINITY OF BUFFALO/BRULE COUNTIES SD. LATEST SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACED A SURFACE LOW OVER CENTRAL SD WITH A WARM FRONT EXTENDING SOUTHEAST ACROSS CENTRAL IA. WARM-AIR ADVECTION REMAINS STRONGEST ACROSS NORTHWEST IA...WHERE LATEST KDMX VWP AND RAP ANALYSES DEPICT A 45-KT SOUTHWEST FLOW AROUND 850 MB. FARTHER WEST ACROSS CENTRAL SD...WEAKER WARM ADVECTION WAS OCCURRING IN CONJUNCTION WITH A 25-30 KT LOW-LEVEL JET. STORMS ACROSS NORTHWEST IA WILL LIKELY REMAIN SEVERE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS WHILE MOVING SOUTHEAST ALONG THE INSTABILITY GRADIENT AND WITH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF AROUND 60 KTS. DAMAGING WINDS AND SEVERE HAIL WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE. STORMS OVER CENTRAL SD HAVE RECENTLY STRENGTHENED TO SEVERE LEVELS AGAIN AND WILL LIKELY REMAIN STRONG/SEVERE WHILE MOVING EAST/SOUTHEAST INTO WESTERN PORTIONS OF WW 283 WITHIN AN ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY MODERATE ELEVATED BUOYANCY AND 45-50 KTS OF EFFECTIVE SHEAR. STORMS ACROSS SOUTHERN SECTIONS OF WW 284 HAVE LARGELY REMAINED SUB SEVERE WHILE MOVING SOUTHEAST OVER EASTERN IA/WEST-CENTRAL IL. ALTHOUGH SOME SEVERE THREAT WILL REMAIN GIVEN WEAK-MODERATE ELEVATED INSTABILITY AND AMPLE EFFECTIVE SHEAR...THE TENDENCY FOR REPEATED STORM MOVEMENT OVER THE SAME AREAS WILL RESULT IN A CONTINUED HEAVY RAIN/FLASH FLOOD THREAT /REFERENCE WPC MPD NUMBER 373/. ..BUNTING.. 06/22/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE STORMS OVER WEST-CENTRAL IL WILL LIKELY CONTINUE SOUTHEAST TOWARDS CENTRAL IL DURING THE EARLY MORNING HOURS. A NEW WATCH MAY BE NEEDED TO ACCOUNT FOR A SEVERE WIND AND HAIL THREAT WITH THESE STORMS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COMPLEX OF SEVERE STORMS OVER HENDERSON/WARREN COUNTIES IN WEST-CENTRAL IL AS OF 0855Z HAS A HISTORY OF SEVERE WIND GUSTS AND RADAR INDICATIONS OF LARGE HAIL AS IT MOVES SOUTHEAST AT 35 MPH. THE SEVERE THREAT MAY CONTINUE TO THE EAST/SOUTHEAST OF WW 284 OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS AS THE STORMS MOVE ALONG THE INSTABILITY GRADIENT WITHIN A ZONE OF WARM-AIR ADVECTION. LATEST HIGH-RESOLUTION GUIDANCE INCLUDING THE 00Z NSSL WRF AND THE 05Z ESRL HRRR ARE IN AGREEMENT WITH THIS SCENARIO...AND CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR THE POSSIBILITY OF A NEW WW INTO CENTRAL IL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE RISK MAY CONTINUE FOR AN HOUR OR SO BEYOND THE SCHEDULED 10Z EXPIRATION OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 284 AND A LOCAL EXTENSION IN TIME MAY BE NECESSARY FOR WESTERN PORTIONS OF THE WATCH...HOWEVER A DOWNSTREAM WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WERE LOCATED OVER LYMAN AND BUFFALO COUNTIES SD AT 0940Z AND WILL MOVE INTO WESTERN PORTIONS OF WW 284 NEAR THE SCHEDULED EXPIRATION AT 10Z. THE IMMEDIATE DOWNSTREAM ENVIRONMENT WILL REMAIN FAVORABLE FOR A CONTINUED BUT ISOLATED SEVERE RISK FOR ANOTHER HOUR OR TWO GIVEN 1000 J/KG OF MUCAPE AND AROUND 40 KTS OF EFFECTIVE SHEAR. GIVEN EXPECTATIONS OF AN ISOLATED/SHORT-DURATION SEVERE THREAT A DOWNSTREAM WATCH IS NOT CURRENTLY EXPECTED...HOWEVER A SHORT-TERM EXTENSION IN TIME MAY BE NEEDED ACROSS FAR WESTERN PORTIONS OF THE WATCH. ..BUNTING.. 06/22/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
